executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are among the tightest segments. The Daily Check from 2026-08-24 reviewed eight currently relevant items; there is no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields could ease pressure but will reach the market with a lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
